parameters.command:
set -eu; BUCKET='YOUR_S3_BUCKET'; SERVER=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || printf 'unknown'); DATABASE='YOUR_DATABASE'; PREFIX="s3://${BUCKET}/postgres/${SERVER}/$(date +%Y/%m/%d)/"; line=$(aws s3 ls "$PREFIX" --recursive | awk '$3 > 0 && $4 ~ /\.sql\.gz$/ {print}' | sort | tail -1 || true); if test -n "$line"; then stamp=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $1" "$2}'); size=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $3}'); key=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $4}'); object_epoch=$(date -d "$stamp" +%s); age=$(( $(date +%s) - object_epoch )); if test "$size" -gt 0 && test "$age" -le 86400; then status=OK; else status=FAILED; fi; else status=FAILED; size=0; key=none; age=-1; fi; printf 'STATUS=%s
SERVER=%s
DATABASE=%s
PREFIX=%s
OBJECT=%s
SIZE=%s
AGE_SECONDS=%s
' "$status" "$SERVER" "$DATABASE" "$PREFIX" "$key" "$size" "$age"
